QuestInfo.name: Mark of Friendship
QuestInfo.0: Moonbeam is clearly upset, trying to hold her tears back. Seems like she already cried a lot already. You don't know what to do, but you feel like you should say something to make her feel at ease.
QuestInfo.2: Moonbeam knew that you would be leaving at one point or another. You carved a mark of your friendship on the Fox Tree, and promised Moonbeam that you would be back as soon as you can. She smiled, but the rain kept pouring on.
